raw: A passenger may only be carried if the motorcycle's engine exceeds 50cc, and the passenger must be seated in a sidecar or astride a pillion.
formatted:
A passenger may only be carried if:
(i) the motorcycle's **engine exceeds 50cc**, and
(ii) the passenger is **seated in a sidecar** or **astride a pillion**.

raw: Riders must travel in single file within the same lane, except briefly to overtake another motorcycle; two motorcycles may not overtake another vehicle at the same time.
formatted:
Riders must:
(i) travel in **single file** within the same lane, except briefly to **overtake another motorcycle**, and
(ii) ensure **two motorcycles do not overtake** another vehicle at the same time.

raw: A sidecar must be attached to the left side of the motorcycle, and may not be fitted to a motorcycle with an engine under 50cc.
formatted:
A sidecar must:
(i) be attached to the **left side** of the motorcycle, and
(ii) **not be fitted** to a motorcycle with an engine **under 50cc**.

raw: Pedestrians may not cross while the red man light is showing; if the red man flashes, pedestrians already in the road must finish crossing quickly, while those not yet in the road must wait for the green man.
formatted:
Pedestrian signal rules:
(i) pedestrians **may not cross** while the **red man light** is showing,
(ii) if the **red man flashes**, pedestrians already in the road must **finish crossing quickly**, and
(iii) those not yet in the road must **wait for the green man**.

raw: A vehicle left in the same place for more than 24 hours (outside an urban area) or 7 days (within an urban area) is deemed abandoned by its owner.
formatted:
A vehicle is deemed **abandoned by its owner** if left in the same place for:
(i) more than **24 hours** outside an urban area, or
(ii) more than **7 days** within an urban area.

raw: Don't cause a vehicle's wheel to drag or spin on the roadway (except in an emergency), use chocks or shoes between a moving wheel and the road surface, or otherwise use or move a vehicle in a way that damages the road.
formatted:
Do not:
(i) cause a vehicle's **wheel to drag or spin** on the roadway (except in an emergency),
(ii) use **chocks or shoes** between a moving wheel and the road surface, or
(iii) use or move a vehicle in a way that **damages the road**.

raw: Animal-drawn vehicles, pedal cycles, motorcycles under 50cc or electrically propelled, motor quadrucycles, disability vehicles under 230kg, and tractors (outside road construction or maintenance use) may not use a freeway.
formatted:
The following **may not use a freeway**:
(i) **animal-drawn vehicles** and **pedal cycles**,
(ii) **motorcycles under 50cc** or electrically propelled, **motor quadrucycles**, and **disability vehicles under 230kg**, and
(iii) **tractors** (outside road construction or maintenance use).

raw: Don't park where a traffic officer directs otherwise, in contravention of a sign, where stopping isn't permitted, where the vehicle would obscure a road sign, on the sidewalk, or blocking a private or public vehicular entrance.
formatted:
Don't park:
(i) where a **traffic officer directs otherwise** or in **contravention of a sign**,
(ii) where **stopping isn't permitted** or where the vehicle would **obscure a road sign**, or
(iii) **on the sidewalk** or blocking a **private or public vehicular entrance**.

raw: Don't stop alongside or opposite an excavation or obstruction if it would obstruct or endanger traffic, in a tunnel, subway, or on a bridge (or within 6 metres of one), where the roadway has been narrowed (or within 6 metres of the narrowing), in contravention of a sign, facing oncoming traffic on the right side, alongside another vehicle on a road under 9 metres wide, within a railway level crossing, within 9 metres of a pedestrian crossing's approach side, or anywhere it would endanger or obstruct traffic.
formatted:
Don't stop:
(i) alongside or opposite an **excavation or obstruction** if it would obstruct traffic,
(ii) in a **tunnel, subway, or on a bridge** (or within 6 metres of one),
(iii) where the roadway has been **narrowed** (or within 6 metres of the narrowing),
(iv) in **contravention of a sign** or facing oncoming traffic on the **right side**,
(v) alongside another vehicle on a road **under 9 metres wide**,
(vi) within a **railway level crossing** or within **9 metres of a pedestrian crossing's** approach side, or
(vii) anywhere it would **endanger or obstruct traffic**.

raw: A rider may not carry a person, animal, or bulky object in front of them; a non-bulky object may be carried if securely attached and doesn't obstruct the rider's view or control.
formatted:
Motorcycle carrying rules:
(i) a rider **may not carry** a person, animal, or **bulky object in front** of them, and
(ii) a **non-bulky object** may be carried if **securely attached** and doesn't **obstruct view or control**.

raw: A heavy motor vehicle may not be used if its fuel tank, carburettor, or fuel pipes are defective or exposed as a danger, if the fuel tank lacks an effective cap, or if the electrical wiring and battery aren't properly installed, insulated, and maintained.
formatted:
A heavy motor vehicle may not be used if:
(i) its **fuel tank, carburettor, or fuel pipes** are defective or exposed as a danger,
(ii) the fuel tank **lacks an effective cap**, or
(iii) the **electrical wiring and battery** aren't properly installed, insulated, and maintained.

raw: A Code 2 learner's licence authorises driving any motor vehicle or combination (other than a motorcycle or tricycle) with tare, GVM, or GCM not exceeding 3500kg, only under the direct supervision of a licensed driver for that class. Minimum age is 17; valid for 24 months from the test date.
formatted:
A **Code 2 learner's licence**:
(i) authorises driving any motor vehicle or combination (other than a motorcycle or tricycle) with tare, GVM, or GCM **not exceeding 3500kg**,
(ii) requires **direct supervision** of a licensed driver for that class,
(iii) requires a **minimum age of 17**, and
(iv) is **valid for 24 months** from the test date.

raw: A Code 3 learner's licence authorises driving any motor vehicle or combination (other than a motorcycle, tricycle, or quadrucycle) -- covering both light and heavy vehicles -- only under the direct supervision of a licensed driver for that class. Minimum age is 18; valid for 24 months from the test date.
formatted:
A **Code 3 learner's licence**:
(i) authorises driving any motor vehicle or combination (other than a motorcycle, tricycle, or quadrucycle) covering **light and heavy vehicles**,
(ii) requires **direct supervision** of a licensed driver for that class,
(iii) requires a **minimum age of 18**, and
(iv) is **valid for 24 months** from the test date.

raw: Motorcycles, motor tricycles, and trailers need only a rear number plate; all other motor vehicles need one at the front and one at the rear.
formatted:
Number plate requirements:
(i) motorcycles, motor tricycles, and trailers need only a **rear number plate**, and
(ii) all other motor vehicles need **one at the front and one at the rear**.

raw: A driver must ensure a child uses an appropriate child restraint where available, or a seatbelt if no restraint is available; if no belted seat is available and the vehicle has a rear seat, the child must sit there.
formatted:
A driver must ensure:
(i) a child uses an **appropriate child restraint** where available, or a **seatbelt** if no restraint is available, and
(ii) if no belted seat is available and the vehicle has a rear seat, the child must **sit there**.

raw: Don't give a hand signal on a freeway (except for reasons beyond your control), be on a freeway on foot, or leave an animal where it could stray onto one.
formatted:
Freeway restrictions:
(i) don't give a **hand signal** on a freeway (except for reasons beyond your control),
(ii) don't be on a **freeway on foot**, and
(iii) don't leave an **animal** where it could stray onto one.

raw: A stationary vehicle must place a warning triangle at least 45 metres away in the direction traffic will approach from, at roughly the same distance from the roadway edge as the vehicle's own centre, with the reflective side facing oncoming traffic.
formatted:
A stationary vehicle must place a warning triangle:
(i) at least **45 metres away** in the direction traffic will approach from,
(ii) at roughly the **same distance from the roadway edge** as the vehicle's own centre, and
(iii) with the **reflective side facing oncoming traffic**.

raw: A warning triangle isn't required if the vehicle is stopped in a loading zone, on a traffic officer's or sign's direction, because of other traffic while the driver stays in the driving seat, or during a state or municipal function.
formatted:
A warning triangle isn't required if the vehicle is stopped:
(i) in a **loading zone** or on a **traffic officer's or sign's direction**,
(ii) because of other traffic while the driver **stays in the driving seat**, or
(iii) during a **state or municipal function**.

raw: A double-deck bus (with load) may not exceed 4.65 metres in height; any other motor vehicle may not exceed 4.3 metres.
formatted:
Maximum vehicle height limits:
(i) a **double-deck bus** (with load) may not exceed **4.65 metres** in height, and
(ii) any **other motor vehicle** may not exceed **4.3 metres**.

raw: A bus with a front wheel track over 1.9 metres may not exceed 2.6 metres overall width; a goods vehicle of 12,000kg GVM or more may not exceed 2.6 metres; any other vehicle may not exceed 2.5 metres.
formatted:
Maximum overall width limits:
(i) a bus with a front wheel track over 1.9 metres may not exceed **2.6 metres**,
(ii) a goods vehicle of 12,000kg GVM or more may not exceed **2.6 metres**, and
(iii) any other vehicle may not exceed **2.5 metres**.

raw: The section of a goods vehicle carrying persons must be enclosed to at least 350mm above a seated person, or 900mm above a standing person.
formatted:
The section of a goods vehicle carrying persons must be enclosed to:
(i) at least **350mm above a seated person**, or
(ii) at least **900mm above a standing person**.

raw: A motorcycle's load (or sidecar load) may not project more than 600mm in front of the front axle, 900mm behind the rear axle, 450mm to either side, or 300mm beyond the sidecar wheel.
formatted:
A motorcycle's load (or sidecar load) may not project:
(i) more than **600mm in front** of the front axle,
(ii) more than **900mm behind** the rear axle,
(iii) more than **450mm to either side**, or
(iv) more than **300mm beyond** the sidecar wheel.

raw: A light or heavy vehicle's goods may not project sideways from the centre-line by more than 1.3 metres (bus or goods vehicle over 12,000kg GVM) or 1.25 metres (any other vehicle), excluding mirrors or indicators.
formatted:
A light or heavy vehicle's goods may not project sideways from the centre-line by:
(i) more than **1.3 metres** (bus or goods vehicle over 12,000kg GVM), or
(ii) more than **1.25 metres** (any other vehicle), excluding mirrors or indicators.

raw: A light or heavy vehicle's goods may not project more than 300mm beyond the front of the vehicle, or 1.8 metres beyond the rear.
formatted:
A light or heavy vehicle's goods may not project:
(i) more than **300mm beyond the front** of the vehicle, or
(ii) more than **1.8 metres beyond the rear**.

raw: A learner's licence test covers rules of the road and related legislation, road traffic signs/signals/markings, and vehicle controls. Once passed, the learner's licence is valid for 24 months.
formatted:
A learner's licence test covers:
(i) **rules of the road** and related legislation,
(ii) **road traffic signs**, signals, and markings, and
(iii) **vehicle controls**.
Once passed, the learner's licence is **valid for 24 months**.

raw: A person is disqualified if suffering from uncontrolled epilepsy, disabling giddiness or fainting (e.g. from hypertension), a mental illness requiring detention or treatment, a condition causing muscular incoordination, uncontrolled diabetes mellitus, defective vision below the prescribed standard, or any other disease or defect likely to prevent safe driving. Deafness alone is not disqualifying.
formatted:
A person is disqualified if suffering from:
(i) **uncontrolled epilepsy**, disabling giddiness, or fainting,
(ii) a **mental illness** requiring detention or treatment, or a condition causing **muscular incoordination**,
(iii) **uncontrolled diabetes mellitus**, or **defective vision** below the prescribed standard, or
(iv) any other disease or defect likely to **prevent safe driving**.
Deafness alone is not disqualifying.

raw: A Code 1 learner's licence authorises riding a motorcycle (but not a motor quadrucycle) on a public road. Minimum age is 16; under 18 you're limited to a 125cc engine; no passengers may be carried.
formatted:
A **Code 1 learner's licence**:
(i) authorises **riding a motorcycle** (but not a motor quadrucycle) on a public road,
(ii) requires a **minimum age of 16** (under 18 you're limited to a **125cc engine**), and
(iii) prohibits carrying **any passengers**.

raw: These lighting rules don't apply to a vehicle parked off the roadway, in a demarcated parking place, or within 12 metres of a lit street lamp illuminating the road.
formatted:
These lighting rules don't apply to a vehicle stopped:
(i) **parked off the roadway**,
(ii) in a **demarcated parking place**, or
(iii) within **12 metres of a lit street lamp** illuminating the road.

raw: Within an urban area, don't park within 9 metres of the approach side of a pedestrian crossing, within 5 metres of an intersection, over a traffic signal's mechanism, more than 450mm from the kerb, on a road narrower than 5.5 metres, or on a traffic island, pedestrian mall, or pedestrian lane.
formatted:
Within an urban area, don't park:
(i) within **9 metres** of the approach side of a pedestrian crossing,
(ii) within **5 metres** of an intersection or over a **traffic signal's mechanism**,
(iii) more than **450mm from the kerb** or on a road **narrower than 5.5 metres**, or
(iv) on a **traffic island, pedestrian mall, or pedestrian lane**.

raw: If these details haven't already been given to a traffic officer at the scene, the accident must be reported to a police station within 24 hours, along with any further information required.
formatted: If details haven't been given to an officer at the scene, the accident must be **reported to a police station within 24 hours**, along with any **further information required**.

raw: Gross Combination Mass (GCM) is the maximum mass of a vehicle combination (including the drawing vehicle) and its load, as specified by the manufacturer or, failing that, the registering authority.
formatted: **Gross Combination Mass (GCM)** is the **maximum mass** of a vehicle combination (including drawing vehicle) and its load, as specified by the **manufacturer or registering authority**.

raw: Gross Vehicle Mass (GVM) is the maximum mass of a vehicle and its load, as specified by the manufacturer or, failing that, the registering authority.
formatted: **Gross Vehicle Mass (GVM)** is the **maximum mass** of a vehicle and its load, as specified by the **manufacturer or registering authority**.

raw: A driver may not hold a cellular or other communication device in one or both hands, or with any other part of the body, while driving.
formatted: A driver may **not hold a cellular or communication device** in one or both hands, or with any other part of the body, **while driving**.

raw: No person may drive a motor vehicle on a public road except under a licence issued in terms of the National Road Traffic Act, and must keep that licence (or document) with them in the vehicle.
formatted: No person may drive a motor vehicle on a public road except under a **licence issued in terms of the Act**, and must **keep that licence with them** in the vehicle.

raw: A licence to drive a motor vehicle is issued by a driving licence testing centre, and is either a provisional licence (a learner's licence) or a full driving licence.
formatted: A driving licence is issued by a DLTC and is either a **provisional licence (learner's)** or a **full driving licence**.

raw: A learner's licence application is made at a DLTC on form LL1, accompanied by two identical photos, acceptable identification (plus a copy), and the appropriate fee; applicants 65 or older must also submit a medical certificate (form MC) from a medical practitioner or occupational health practitioner.
formatted:
A learner's licence application requirements:
(i) apply at a DLTC on **form LL1** with two identical photos, **acceptable ID (plus copy)**, and the fee, and
(ii) applicants **65 or older** must also submit a **medical certificate (form MC)** from a registered practitioner.

raw: A licence holder who permanently changes their place of residence must notify the registering authority of their new residential and postal address within 14 days.
formatted: A licence holder who permanently changes residence must **notify the registering authority** of their new address **within 14 days**.

raw: An owner, operator, or person in charge of a vehicle may not employ or permit anyone to drive it on a public road unless that person is licensed to drive it.
formatted: An owner, operator, or person in charge may **not employ or permit anyone to drive** a vehicle unless that person is **licensed to drive it**.

raw: To 'park' means to keep a vehicle stationary for longer than is reasonably necessary to load or unload people or goods, excluding delays beyond the driver's control.
formatted: To **'park'** means to keep a vehicle stationary for **longer than is reasonably necessary** to load or unload people or goods, excluding **delays beyond control**.

raw: A motor vehicle may still be operated for up to 21 days after its licence expires (a 'period of grace'), provided the previous licence number and disc are displayed in the prescribed manner.
formatted: A motor vehicle may still be operated for **up to 21 days** after its licence expires (a 'period of grace'), provided the **previous licence number and disc** are displayed.

raw: 'Drawing' means towing a vehicle that is designed or adapted solely to be drawn, using a vehicle designed or adapted solely for that purpose -- as distinct from general 'towing'.
formatted: **'Drawing'** means towing a vehicle designed or adapted **solely to be drawn**, using a vehicle designed **solely for that purpose** -- as distinct from general 'towing'.

raw: A driving licence card is a driving licence card issued in terms of the National Road Traffic Act.
formatted: A **driving licence card** is a card issued in terms of the **National Road Traffic Act**.

raw: 'Driving time' is any period a driver occupies the driver's seat of a vehicle while it is being operated on a public road, or while the engine is running.
formatted: **'Driving time'** is any period a driver **occupies the driver's seat** while the vehicle is operated or while the **engine is running**.

raw: The 'front end' of a vehicle is the part that projects furthest forward (for a semi-trailer, a line through the kingpin connecting the vehicle's widest point ahead of it).
formatted: The **'front end'** of a vehicle is the part that **projects furthest forward** (for a semi-trailer, a line through the kingpin connecting its widest point ahead).

raw: An instructor is someone who, for direct reward, teaches another person to drive a motor vehicle, or teaches the rules of the road or road signs for a learner's or driving licence.
formatted: An **instructor** is someone who, for direct reward, **teaches another person to drive** or teaches road rules/signs for a licence.

raw: The kerb line is the boundary between the shoulder and the verge, or, where there's no shoulder, the boundary between the edge of the roadway and the verge.
formatted: The **kerb line** is the boundary between the **shoulder and the verge**, or between the **edge of the roadway and the verge** where there is no shoulder.

raw: Overall length is the distance between the front end and rear end of a vehicle, or (for a combination) between the front of the leading vehicle and the rear of the rearmost vehicle.
formatted: **Overall length** is the distance between the **front end and rear end** of a vehicle, or between the **front of leading vehicle and rear of rearmost vehicle**.

raw: Overall height is the distance from ground level to the highest point of the vehicle or its load, excluding overhead electrical contacting gear or a catwalk on electrically driven vehicles.
formatted: **Overall height** is the distance from ground level to the **highest point of the vehicle or load**, excluding overhead electrical gear.

raw: Overall width is the distance between two planes parallel to the vehicle's centre-line, touching the widest projecting points on either side -- excluding side mirrors, direction indicators, or small fitments like air deflectors.
formatted: **Overall width** is the distance between parallel planes touching the **widest projecting points** on either side -- **excluding mirrors and indicators**.

raw: The 'owner' of a vehicle is the person with the right to use and enjoy it under common law or a contractual agreement, or a motor dealer in possession of it for sale.
formatted: The **'owner'** of a vehicle is the person with the **right to use and enjoy it** under law/contract, or a **motor dealer** in possession of it for sale.

raw: A vehicle may not use an adjustable spot lamp on a public road, except official vehicles (ambulance, fire-fighting, police, traffic control), vehicles used by a medical practitioner or veterinarian for professional duties, or a breakdown vehicle or utility vehicle working at an accident, breakdown, or overhead line inspection.
formatted:
A vehicle **may not use an adjustable spot lamp**, except:
(i) **official vehicles** (ambulance, fire-fighting, police, traffic control),
(ii) vehicles used by a **medical practitioner or veterinarian**, or
(iii) **breakdown or utility vehicles** working at an emergency or overhead line inspection.

raw: A vehicle must be fitted with a rear-view mirror giving a clear view of traffic behind in clear weather (tractors are excepted).
formatted: A vehicle must be fitted with a **rear-view mirror** giving a clear view of traffic behind (**tractors are excepted**).

raw: A motor car, minibus, bus, or goods vehicle must have both an exterior mirror on the driving side and an interior mirror -- or two exterior mirrors if the interior one doesn't give a clear rear view.
formatted:
A motor car, minibus, bus, or goods vehicle must have:
(i) both an **exterior mirror on the driving side** and an **interior mirror**, or
(ii) **two exterior mirrors** if the interior one doesn't give a clear rear view.

raw: Helmets aren't required if the motorcycle has SABS-compliant seatbelts and the engine cannot run unless the rider and any passenger are wearing them.
formatted: Helmets aren't required if the motorcycle has **SABS-compliant seatbelts** and the engine cannot run unless the rider and passenger are **wearing them**.

raw: A vehicle may not be used if its fuel tank, carburettor, or fuel pipes are defective or exposed as a danger, if the fuel tank lacks an effective cap, or if the electrical wiring and battery aren't properly installed, insulated, and maintained.
formatted:
A vehicle may not be used if:
(i) its **fuel tank, carburettor, or fuel pipes** are defective or exposed as a danger,
(ii) the fuel tank **lacks an effective cap**, or
(iii) the **electrical wiring and battery** aren't properly installed, insulated, and maintained.

raw: Maximum vehicle lengths: 8 metres for a trailer (not semi-trailer) under 12,000kg GVM; 12.5 metres for one over 12,000kg GVM; 18.5 metres for an articulated motor vehicle; 22 metres for a bus-train or any combination of motor vehicles; 12.5 metres for any other vehicle.
formatted:
Maximum vehicle length limits:
(i) **8 metres** for a trailer (not semi-trailer) under 12,000kg GVM,
(ii) **12.5 metres** for a trailer over 12,000kg GVM or any single vehicle,
(iii) **18.5 metres** for an articulated motor vehicle, and
(iv) **22 metres** for a bus-train or combination of motor vehicles.

raw: 'Roadworthy', for a vehicle, means it complies with the relevant legal provisions and is otherwise fit to be operated on a public road.
formatted: **'Roadworthy'**, for a vehicle, means it complies with relevant legal provisions and is **fit to be operated on a public road**.

raw: A service brake is a brake, normally a footbrake, used to reduce a vehicle's speed or bring it to a stop.
formatted: A **service brake** is a brake, normally a **footbrake**, used to reduce speed or bring a vehicle to a stop.

raw: 'Towing' means towing a vehicle that is not designed or adapted solely to be drawn -- as distinct from 'drawing', which refers to vehicles built solely for that purpose.
formatted: **'Towing'** means towing a vehicle **not designed or adapted solely to be drawn** -- as distinct from 'drawing'.

raw: On any road close to water, harbours.
formatted: On **any road close to water**, or **harbours**.

raw: At obstructions such as traffic islands. Only one of these signs will be displayed at a time.
formatted: At **obstructions** such as **traffic islands** (only one sign displayed at a time).

raw: On a public road where the road is narrow, near an intersection or where a parked vehicle can impair the vision of other drivers.
formatted: On a public road where the **road is narrow**, **near an intersection**, or where a parked vehicle can **impair vision**.

raw: On any public road. The sign may be supplemented by a red "no stopping line".
formatted: On **any public road** (may be supplemented by a red **'no stopping line'**).

raw: In areas where there are farms and other activities that require agricultural vehicles.
formatted: In areas where there are **farms and activities** requiring **agricultural vehicles**.

raw: In areas where there many tourist tractions.
formatted: In areas where there are **many tourist attractions**.

raw: On a public road where the road is narrow, near an intersection, or where a parked vehicle can impair the vision of other drivers.
formatted: On a public road where the **road is narrow**, **near an intersection**, or where a parked vehicle can **impair vision**.

raw: In areas where there is high traffic congestion, at the scene of an accident or the normal traffic signals are not operational.
formatted: In areas where there is **high traffic congestion**, at the **scene of an accident**, or when normal traffic signals are **not operational**.

raw: In areas where there is road works ahead, herdsman leading cattle or other animals across or next to a roadway.
formatted: In areas where there is **road works ahead**, or a **herdsman leading cattle or other animals** across or next to a roadway.

raw: In areas where there is road works ahead, herdsman leading cattle or other animals across or next to a roadway.
formatted: In areas where there is **road works ahead**, or a **herdsman leading cattle or other animals** across or next to a roadway.

raw: At the beginning of or entrance to a carriageway, lane or path.
formatted: At the **beginning of or entrance to** any **carriageway, lane or path**.

raw: On any public road where it is necessary to close the road for general traffic. The temporary sign is usually displayed at road works.
formatted: On **any public road** where it is necessary to **close the road for general traffic** (usually displayed at road works).

raw: On any road before you reach the place where another road joins your road from the left (W107) (TW107) or from the right (W108) (TW108).
formatted: On **any road** before you reach the place where **another road joins your road** from the left or right.

raw: Indicate that a road or part of a road may be used by motorcyclists only. Motorcyclists must follow the route indicated by the road traffic sign.
formatted:
Indicates that a road or part of a road:
(i) may be **used by motorcyclists only**, and
(ii) motorcyclists **must follow the route indicated** by the sign.

raw: To allow minibuses to take up and drop passengers off. Such a vehicle must display an appropriate emblem, logo or any other indication that they are minibuses.
formatted: To allow minibuses to **take up and drop passengers off** (such a vehicle must **display an appropriate emblem or logo**).

raw: To warn that the carriageway ahead narrows to a width that will make it possible for only one vehicle at a time to pass.
formatted: To warn that the carriageway ahead narrows to a width that will allow **only one vehicle at a time to pass**.

raw: To warn that traffic could merge from the left (W112, TW112) or from the right (W114, TW114) at sharp angles / To warn that the road you are travelling on will soon split in two and you will have to make a choice which road to take.
formatted:
Road split and merge warnings:
(i) to warn that **traffic could merge from the left or right** at sharp angles, or
(ii) to warn that the road **will soon split in two** requiring a choice of route.

raw: To warn that the tarred road you are driving on will end soon and will have a gravel surface ahead.
formatted: To warn that the **tarred road will end soon** and will have a **gravel surface ahead**.

raw: Inform you of the speed limit applicable on this road. The restriction applies from the sign.
formatted: To inform you of the **speed limit applicable on this road** (applies from the sign).

raw: To point out the direction to a transport terminus from a road that would otherwise have taken you past the terminus.
formatted: To point out the **direction to a transport terminus** from a road that would otherwise have taken you past it.

raw: To warn that there is a yield sign ahead, which you may not be able to see in time without a warning.
formatted: To warn that there is a **yield sign ahead**, which you may not be able to see in time.

raw: To indicate in good time exits that is close together, all leading to the same town.
formatted: To indicate in good time **exits that are close together**, all **leading to the same town**.

raw: To warn that there is a depression or a ridge in the road, or that the road in general is uneven and potholed.
formatted: To warn that there is a **depression or ridge in the road**, or that the road is **uneven and potholed**.

raw: To warn that the material of the road shoulder may be softer than reasonably expected and could be dangerous for anyone who wants to move of the road.
formatted: To warn that the **road shoulder material may be soft** and **dangerous for moving off the road**.

raw: To warn that the road does not continue beyond the sign and that a turn either to the left or to the right must be made.
formatted: To warn that the **road does not continue beyond the sign** and that a **turn left or right must be made**.

raw: To indicate that the regulatory sign applies only for the period(s) or during conditions indicated on this sign.
formatted: To indicate that the regulatory sign **applies only for the periods or conditions indicated**.

raw: These are two different signs, which are mounted back to back. It indicates whether you may proceed or must stop.
formatted: Mounted back to back to indicate whether you **may proceed or must stop**.

raw: To warn that you are approaching an intersection where you have to yield to cross-traffic. (The thicker leg of the cross on the sign indicates which road has priority.)
formatted: To warn that you are approaching an intersection where you **have to yield to cross-traffic** (thicker leg indicates priority).

raw: To warn that there are isolated and particularly new traffic lights or traffic lights near an isolated traffic light at a pedestrian crossing ahead.
formatted: To warn that there are **isolated or new traffic lights** ahead.

raw: To warn that the double-lane road you are driving on narrows by a full lane from the left (W215 or TW215) or from the right-hand side (W214 or TW 214).
formatted: To warn that the double-lane road **narrows by a full lane** from the left or right side.

raw: To warn that there are speed humps on the carriageway ahead which require a reduction of speed.
formatted: To warn that there are **speed humps on the carriageway ahead** requiring a reduction of speed.

raw: To warn that there is a possibility of electrical shock from the overhead electrical power cables on the road ahead.
formatted: To warn that there is a possibility of **electrical shock from overhead power cables** on the road ahead.

raw: To compel you to give priority to pedestrians crossing the road or wanting to cross the road.
formatted: To compel you to **give priority to pedestrians** crossing or wanting to cross the road.

raw: To warn you that there is a traffic circle ahead where they must expect to yield.
formatted: To warn you that there is a **traffic circle ahead** where drivers **must expect to yield**.

raw: To allow traffic turning left, to do so (if it can be done without interfering with cross traffic) without stopping.
formatted: To allow **traffic turning left** to do so **without stopping**, if safe.

raw: To warn that the road ahead narrows from the left (W330, TW330) or from the right-hand (W329, TW329) side.
formatted: To warn that the road ahead **narrows from the left or right-hand side**.

raw: To warn that tractors or other slow-moving agricultural vehicles could cross or enter the road ahead.
formatted: To warn that **tractors or slow-moving agricultural vehicles** could cross or enter the road ahead.

raw: To warn that there is a possibility reduced visibility on the road ahead that might cause a hazard to road users.
formatted: To warn that there is a possibility of **reduced visibility from fog or smoke** ahead.

raw: To warn that there is overall width of vehicles restriction as indicated in metres on the road ahead.
formatted: To warn that there is an **overall width restriction** as indicated in metres on the road ahead.

raw: To indicate that a route of equal or higher status can be entered from the road on which you are travelling. This new route consists of a pair of one-way roadways.
formatted: To indicate that a **route of equal or higher status** can be entered, consisting of a **pair of one-way roadways**.

raw: To inform in advance that a particular numbered route changes direction at the intersection ahead or that the cross-street at the intersection ahead is a numbered class-B route.
formatted: To inform in advance that a **numbered route changes direction** or that the cross-street is a **numbered class-B route**.

raw: To indicate the numbers of the routes leading from this intersection and destinations that can be reached from this intersection.
formatted: To indicate the **numbers of routes and destinations** leading from this intersection.

raw: To warn drivers that the lane indicated by this marking can be used for traffic from the opposite direction at various times of day or night.
formatted: To warn drivers that the indicated lane can be **used by traffic from the opposite direction** at various times.

raw: To confirm the route to a destination and the distance indicated in kilometres to such destinations.
formatted: To **confirm the route to a destination** and the **distance indicated in kilometres**.

raw: To point out the direction of a transport terminus from a route that would otherwise have taken you past a bus terminus, harbour, airport or helipad.
formatted: To point out the **direction of a transport terminus** from a route that would otherwise take you past it.

raw: To warn that there is an obstruction or temporary obstruction next to the road and that the road alignment to the left or right hand side is altered.
formatted: To warn of an **obstruction next to the road** and that the **road alignment is altered**.

raw: To warn that the road ahead curves suddenly to the left (W406, W408, TW406, TW408) or to the right (W405, W407, TW405, TW407).
formatted: To warn that the road ahead **curves suddenly to the left or right**.

raw: To guide you by means of a diagram, which indicates that, the right-hand lane of a two-lane carriageway or part of a carriageway is subject to a compulsory requirement of a 'command' or 'prohibition' regulatory sign. Opposing traffic flow is indicated by a dotted arrow.
formatted: To guide by diagram that the right-hand lane is **subject to a compulsory regulatory sign** (opposing flow shown by dotted arrow).

raw: To warn that the level of the right-hand side of the carriageway is higher than the left-hand side (TW340), or the left-hand side of the carriageway is higher than the right-hand side (TW341).
formatted: To warn that one side of the carriageway is **at a higher level than the other**.

raw: To indicate the numbers of the routes leading from an intersection and destinations that can be reached from this intersection.
formatted: To indicate the **numbers of routes and destinations** leading from an intersection.

raw: To guide you to small locations or to destinations on less travelled routes.
formatted: To guide you to **small locations or destinations** on **less travelled routes**.

raw: To indicate that the road crosses a freeway and show where that freeway is leading to.
formatted: To indicate that the **road crosses a freeway** and show **where that freeway leads**.

raw: To indicate the position of the near-side on-ramp at a freeway access interchange, with the freeway route number and the destination of the freeway.
formatted: To indicate the **position of the near-side on-ramp** at a freeway access interchange with route number and destination.

raw: To indicate that the far-side on-ramp to a freeway access interchange, is some distance ahead and to indicate the route number and the destination that will be reached by turning onto that on-ramp.
formatted: To indicate that the **far-side on-ramp is ahead**, showing the route number and destination reached.

raw: To indicate that the freeway splits ahead and that the lanes lead to different destinations as indicated.
formatted: To indicate that the **freeway splits ahead** and lanes **lead to different destinations**.

raw: To indicate that there is an arrestor bed ahead and to indicate the entrance to such an arrestor bed.
formatted: To indicate that there is an **arrestor bed ahead** and mark its entrance.

raw: To warn that there are two sharp curves ahead in opposite directions. W210 indicates the first curve is to the right and W211 that the first curve is to the left.
formatted: To warn that there are **two sharp curves ahead in opposite directions**.

raw: To guide drivers by means of a diagram, which indicates that, a curved multi-lane carriageway converges with a straight multi-lane carriageway from the left or right, without a decrease in lanes.
formatted: To guide drivers by diagram that a **curved multi-lane carriageway converges** with a straight multi-lane carriageway without decreasing lanes.

raw: To guide you by means of a diagram, which indicates that, a lane merges with another lane or that roadways join.
formatted: To guide by diagram that a **lane merges with another lane** or that **roadways join**.

raw: To inform early which lane at the intersection at the end of the of-ramp, leads to which destination.
formatted: To inform early **which lane at the end of the off-ramp** leads to which destination.

raw: To warn that the traffic lanes are reduced from the left (WM6.1) or right (WM6.3) or from both (WM6.2) sides.
formatted: To warn that **traffic lanes are reduced** from the left, right, or both sides.

raw: To inform you that the road ahead or the road to the left or right ends.
formatted: To inform you that the **road ahead or to the left or right ends**.

raw: To inform you of the existence of a park-and-ride terminus that has a bus (IN9) or train (IN10) service.
formatted: To inform you of the existence of a **park-and-ride terminus** with a bus or train service.

raw: To inform you that the traffic signals on this route are co-ordinated and that the signals will be green at all the subsequent intersections if you maintain the indicated speed.
formatted: To inform you that traffic signals are **co-ordinated for green lights** if you maintain the indicated speed.

raw: To point out that the signals at this intersection does not follow the normal sequence. At a normal intersection you would expect that the signal in your direction will change to green after the signal for cross traffic was yellow. At this intersection your signal may remain red whilst the signal in the opposite direction changes to green.
formatted: To point out that signals at this intersection **do not follow the normal sequence**.

raw: To show that there is a transport modal transfer point or terminus nearby where passengers may change their mode of transport.
formatted: To show that there is a **transport modal transfer point or terminus nearby**.

raw: Indicates that the road or a portion of the road is set aside for use by vehicles conveying dangerous goods
formatted: Indicates that the road or portion of the road is **set aside for vehicles conveying dangerous goods**.

raw: To indicate that you must drive to the left or right of an obstruction where the sign is displayed.
formatted: To indicate that you **must drive to the left or right** of an obstruction.

raw: To warn that traffic ahead is being controlled temporarily by a "Stop/Ry-Go" sign.
formatted: To warn that traffic ahead is **controlled temporarily by a 'Stop/Ry-Go' sign**.

raw: To warn that the robot ahead or to which the sign is attached is out of order.
formatted: To warn that the **robot ahead or attached is out of order**.

raw: To allow minibuses to take up and drop passengers off. Such a vehicle must display an appropriate emblem, logo or any other indication that they are minibuses.
formatted: To allow minibuses to **take up and drop passengers off** (displaying proper emblem/logo).

raw: To warn that there is a motor gate to the left or right or in the middle of the road.
formatted: To warn that there is a **motor gate to the left, right, or middle** of the road.

raw: To indicate to the driver that the reservation indicated on the regulatory sign is further restricted by a maximum number of vehicles as indicated on this sign.
formatted: To indicate that the reservation is **further restricted by a maximum number of vehicles**.

raw: To warn that you are approaching an intersection where you have right of way. (The thicker leg of the cross on the signs indicates which road has priority.)
formatted: To warn that you are approaching an intersection where **you have right of way** (thicker leg indicates priority).

raw: To give priority to pedestrians but limit other traffic to emergency vehicles, vehicles loading and off loading goods and maintenance vehicles.
formatted: To **give priority to pedestrians** while limiting other traffic to **emergency, loading, and maintenance vehicles**.

raw: To compel drivers of certain heavy vehicles to use the road or part of the road indicated by this road traffic sign.
formatted: To **compel drivers of certain heavy vehicles** to use the road or part of the road indicated.

raw: Indicates that the road or a portion of the road is set aside for use by midibuses. and that the driver of a midibus shall only use such road or portion of such road.
formatted: Indicates that the road or a portion of the road is **set aside for use by midibuses**.

raw: Indicates that the road or a portion of the road is set aside for use by goods vehicles with a gross vehicle mass (GVM) or a gross combination mass (GCM) exceeding the mass indicated in tonnes by means of a number on such sign.
formatted: Indicates that the road or portion of the road is set aside for **goods vehicles exceeding the indicated mass limit**.

raw: To ensure traffic flow and prevent that driver's views are not impaired by stationary vehicles.
formatted: To **ensure traffic flow** and prevent stationary vehicles from **impairing driver visibility**.

raw: To vehicles from turning around so that it faces the opposite direction.
formatted: To **prohibit vehicles from turning around** so that they face the opposite direction.

raw: To indicate that a freeway begins at the sign and that the rules that apply to freeways are effective from here.
formatted: To indicate that a **freeway begins at the sign** and freeway rules are **effective from here**.

raw: To indicate that a single-carriageway freeway begins at the sign and that all rules that apply to freeways are effective from here.
formatted: To indicate that a **single-carriageway freeway begins** and freeway rules are **effective from here**.

raw: To warn that there may be wild animals on the road or crossing the road.
formatted: To warn that there may be **wild animals on or crossing the road**.

raw: Indicates to a horse rider that horses and riders, whether mounted on or leading a horse, are prohibited beyond such sign.
formatted: Indicates to a horse rider that **horses and riders are prohibited** beyond such sign.

raw: To warn that there is a structure ahead of which the height is indicated on the road traffic sign.
formatted: To warn that there is a **structure ahead** of which the **height is indicated on the sign**.

raw: To reserve a portion of a road or a parking area for use by goods vehicles exceeding the indicated GVM only.
formatted: To reserve a portion of a road or a parking area for **goods vehicles exceeding the indicated GVM only**.

raw: To warn that you are approaching an intersection where you have to turn sharp to the right or left.
formatted: To warn that you are approaching an intersection where you have to **turn sharp right or left**.

raw: To identify that part of the carriageway which is reserved for buses only during the periods indicated on the sign.
formatted: To identify that part of the carriageway **reserved for buses only** during indicated periods.

raw: To prohibit drivers from stopping in the demarcated area because this could prevent other traffic from turning or driving further forward.
formatted: To **prohibit drivers from stopping** in the demarcated area to prevent obstructing traffic.

raw: To indicate an area where you may not stop except for pedestrians crossing or wanting to cross the road or for a vehicle that has already stopped.
formatted: To indicate an area where you **may not stop except for pedestrians crossing** or a stopped vehicle.

raw: To prohibit drivers from stopping where stationary vehicles may disrupt the traffic or where the environment obstructs the view and such vehicles may obstruct the view more.
formatted: To **prohibit drivers from stopping** where stationary vehicles may disrupt traffic or obstruct views.

raw: To warn you that there is a break (intersection or off ramp) in the continuing part of the roadway and to inform you that if you are in a lane that has a line on one side, that lane will soon turn off from the road which you are now travelling.
formatted: To warn that there is a **break in the continuing roadway** and the lane with a side line **will soon turn off**.

raw: At a cycle lane, a road that leads to an airport and where a parking bay is reserved for the handicapped only. As additional markings with standard signs and markings to inform you that an area is reserved for a specific group or that a road is leading to a specific destination.
formatted: To inform that an area is **reserved for a specific group** or leads to a **specific destination**.

raw: To indicate that the sign applies to drivers of vehicles operated by the company, owner or organisation indicated by the logo or words.
formatted: To indicate that the sign applies to drivers of vehicles operated by the **company, owner or organisation indicated**.

raw: To inform you by means of a diagram that the lane below the sign is subject to a compulsory requirement indicated by a 'command' or 'prohibition' regulatory sign.
formatted: To inform by diagram that the lane below is **subject to a compulsory regulatory sign**.

raw: To direct traffic. (i) Flag signal to stop indicating to the driver of a vehicle that he or she shall stop until the proceed flag signal is displayed; and (ii) Flag signal to proceed - indicating to the driver that he or she shall proceed when the flag signal is displayed.
formatted:
To direct traffic via flag signals:
(i) **stop signal** requiring vehicles to stop until proceed signal is displayed, and
(ii) **proceed signal** indicating that vehicles may proceed.

raw: Steady green downward pointing arrow (S16) - Indicates to the driver that he/she may drive in the lane over which the arrow is displayed. Steady red cross (S17) - Indicates to a driver that he/she shall not drive in the lane over which the cross is displayed. Lane might be open to vehicles travelling in the opposite direction. Yellow arrow left (S18) and right (S19) Indicates to the driver that the lane he/she is driving in is closed ahead.
formatted:
Overhead lane control signals:
(i) **steady green downward arrow** indicates you may drive in the lane,
(ii) **steady red cross** indicates you shall not drive in the lane, and
(iii) **yellow arrow left or right** indicates the lane is closed ahead.

raw: To indicate where especially drivers of heavy vehicles who become aware that a vehicle's brakes became defective, can drive such a vehicle of the road and it will be stopped by the gravel section ahead.
formatted: To indicate where defective-brake vehicles can **drive off the road** to be **stopped by a gravel section**.

raw: To indicate that the restriction indicated on the regulatory sign applies in the direction of the arrow.
formatted: To indicate that the restriction **applies in the direction of the arrow**.

raw: To give advance guidance regarding the shape of the intersection ahead, the numbers and destinations of the routes leaving the intersection.
formatted: To give advance guidance regarding the **shape of the intersection** and route numbers/destinations.

raw: To guide you by means of a diagram which indicates that one of the lanes of a carriageway comes to an end.
formatted: To guide by diagram that one of the lanes of a carriageway **comes to an end**.

raw: To prevent cyclists and pedestrians from using a certain road or a certain section of a road where they can cause a danger to themselves or other road users.
formatted: To **prevent cyclists and pedestrians** from using a certain road where they could cause danger.

raw: To prohibit drivers without special authorisation from entering a certain road or section of a road.
formatted: To **prohibit drivers without special authorisation** from entering a closed road.

raw: To prohibit cyclists from using the carriageway, lane or path where they can cause a danger to themselves and to other road users.
formatted: To **prohibit cyclists** from using the carriageway, lane or path where they cause danger.

raw: Signs R302 and TR302 indicate that no other class of vehicle may use that part of the road. Signs: R303 and TR303 indicate where the reserved traffic lane which only buses may enter, starts.
formatted:
Reserved traffic lane rules:
(i) R302/TR302 indicate **no other class of vehicle may use that part of the road**, and
(ii) R303/TR303 indicate **where the bus-only reserved lane starts**.

raw: To prohibit the entry of all vehicles with a mass exceeding 3 500 kg, or vehicles, which have more than 10 seats, except for local access or delivery. To yield right of way to pedestrians in the street. To prohibit vehicles from driving through the area without breaking their journey. To limit the speed of vehicles in the area to 30km/h
formatted:
Pedestrian/traffic zone restrictions:
(i) **prohibits entry** of vehicles >3500kg or >10 seats (except local delivery),
(ii) requires drivers to **yield right of way to pedestrians** and prohibits through-traffic, and
(iii) **limits vehicle speed to 30km/h** in the area.

raw: To give more information about the main message on regulatory, warning or diagrammatical guidance signs.
formatted: To **give more information** about the main message on regulatory, warning or guidance signs.

raw: Indicates to the driver of a vehicle that he or she shall not proceed beyond the sign unless the overall width of the vehicle, is less than the width indicated in metres, by means of a number on such sign.
formatted: Indicates you shall not proceed unless overall vehicle width is **less than the width indicated in metres**.

raw: Indicate that the road or part of the carriageway is reserved for buses only and that only buses may park in the area indicated by sign (R301-P).
formatted: Indicates the road is **reserved for buses only** and only buses may park in the area.

raw: To prevent drivers from stopping where stationary vehicles may disrupt the traffic, or where the environment obstructs the view and such vehicles obstruct the view more.
formatted: To **prevent drivers from stopping** where stationary vehicles disrupt traffic or view.

raw: To inform you that priority must be given to pedestrians crossing or wanting to cross the road at these places.
formatted: To inform you that **priority must be given to pedestrians** crossing or wanting to cross.

raw: To warn that one-way street you are driving on will soon be crossed by a street that carries two-way traffic.
formatted: To warn that the one-way street will soon be **crossed by a street with two-way traffic**.

raw: To indicate that a road or part of a road may be used by cyclists and/or pedestrians only. To indicate to cyclists and pedestrians which part of a road they must use. Signs R113 and TR115 indicate that part of the road is divided and that part may be used by cyclists and pedestrians only. A certain part may be used by cyclists or by pedestrians only, as indicated by the road traffic sign.
formatted:
Pedestrian and cycle lane rules:
(i) to indicate a road set aside for **cyclists and/or pedestrians only**,
(ii) to show **which part of a road** each user group must use, and
(iii) divided signs indicate **separate sub-paths for cyclists or pedestrians**.

raw: To prohibit long vehicles from using a road where such a vehicle will not be able to negotiate a curve or will turn in such a manner that it will disrupt or endanger other traffic.
formatted: To **prohibit long vehicles** from using a road where they cannot safely negotiate curves.

raw: To prohibit pedestrians from proceeding past this sign where they could cause a danger to themselves and to vehicles.
formatted: To **prohibit pedestrians from proceeding** past this sign where they cause danger.

raw: Indicates to the driver of a vehicle that no vehicle which is towing another vehicle shall proceed beyond such sign.
formatted: Indicates that **no vehicle towing another vehicle** shall proceed beyond such sign.

raw: Sign (R305-P) indicates a parking area for vehicles with a GVM of less than 3 500 kg where no time limit applies but a fee must be paid. Sign (R306-P) indicates a parking area that may be used free of charge or at a fee and the maximum time allowed for a vehicle to be parked, is displayed.
formatted:
Parking area rules:
(i) R305-P indicates parking for **vehicles under 3500kg** with paid fee and no time limit, and
(ii) R306-P indicates parking with a **displayed maximum allowed time limit**.

raw: To warn of a series of curves ahead. In the case of W209 the first curve is to the left and in the case of W208 the first bend is to the right.
formatted: To warn of a **series of curves ahead** (W209 first bend left, W208 first bend right).

raw: To warn that your road is first joined by another road from the left hand side first and within a short distance by another from the right hand side (W110,TW110) or from the right first and then from the left (W109,TW109).
formatted: To warn that your road is **joined by two side roads in short succession** from opposite sides.

raw: To warn that curves in the road or other structures on the side of the road make it impossible for vehicles longer than the length indicated on this road sign.
formatted: To warn that curves or structures make it impossible for **vehicles longer than indicated** to proceed.

raw: To inform you by means of a diagram that the number of lanes of the road which you are travelling on will be increased soon. Opposing traffic flow is indicated by a dotted arrow.
formatted: To inform by diagram that the **number of lanes will be increased soon** (opposing flow shown by dotted arrow).

raw: To warn that one or more concealed driveways enter the road you are driving on from the left or right in such a way that you cannot easily see the road or traffic travelling on that road.
formatted: To warn that **one or more concealed driveways enter** from the left or right.

raw: To warn that rocks could fall on the carriageway from the left (W334, TW334) or from the right-hand side (W335, TW335).
formatted: To warn that **rocks could fall on the carriageway** from the left or right-hand side.

raw: To warn about a temporary stop sign, a collision scene, roadblock or similar scene where police are on duty.
formatted: To warn about a **temporary stop sign, collision scene, or roadblock** where police are on duty.

raw: To warn the driver that - the road ahead may be obstructed, there could be pedestrians, rescue teams and police or traffic officers controlling the traffic at the scene, there could be wreckage, injured persons, animals or broken glass on the road surface.
formatted: To warn that the road ahead **may be obstructed by an accident scene or wreckage**.

raw: Bring your vehicle to a stop behind the stop line. If there is no stop line, the front of the vehicle must come to a stand still in line with the stop sign. At a three or four-way stop you may not move off before all the other vehicles which stopped before you have moved off. Proceed only when it is safe.
formatted: Bring your vehicle to a stop behind the stop line. If there is no stop line, the front of the vehicle must **come to a standstill in line with the stop sign**. At a three or four-way stop, **you may not move off** before all vehicles that stopped before you have moved off. **Proceed only when it is safe**.

raw: Do not stop to take up or drop passengers off if you are not driving a mini-bus of the organisation indicated on the sign. You may only wait with or park your mini-bus here if the road traffic sign indicates that the stop is a terminus.
formatted:
Minibus stop rules:
(i) **do not stop to pick up or drop off passengers** unless driving a minibus of the organisation indicated, and
(ii) **you may only wait or park** here if the sign indicates that the stop is a **terminus**.

raw: Look out for trucks that could force you to slow down. Slow down and look out for trucks that want to cross or join the road. Also look out for anything spilt or dropped on the road by the trucks like gravel, sand or water that could affect the handling of your vehicle.
formatted:
Truck hazard instructions:
(i) **look out for trucks** that could force you to slow down, or that **want to cross or join the road**, and
(ii) **look out for spilt materials** like gravel, sand, or water that could **affect your vehicle's handling**.

raw: Slow down and be prepared to stop should the gates be closing or are closed.
formatted: **Slow down** and **be prepared to stop** should the gates be closing or closed.

raw: Slow down and look to the right and left for oncoming trains. If a train is approaching stop in time, but not within the railway crossing reserve.
formatted: **Slow down** and **look left and right** for oncoming trains. If a train is approaching, **stop in time outside the railway reserve**.

raw: Pass the intersection at a safe speed and look out for merging traffic that might not yield. / Decide well in time which road to take. Be on the look out for approaching traffic whose path you will cross when taking the right hand side road.
formatted:
Split and merge action rules:
(i) **pass the intersection at a safe speed** and look out for **merging traffic that might not yield**, or
(ii) **decide well in time which road to take**, looking out for **approaching traffic whose path you will cross**.

raw: Make sure that the route you are travelling on is the route that you want to take to reach your destination.
formatted: **Make sure that the route** you are travelling on is the **route you want to take** to reach your destination.

raw: Be aware that you are entering a roadway with two-way traffic and have to be more careful when overtaking to allow for oncoming vehicles.
formatted: Be aware that you are **entering a roadway with two-way traffic** and have to be **more careful when overtaking**.

raw: Slow down and look out for a ditches or potholes at the joint between the gravel and the tarred surface. Steering will be lighter on the gravel, vehicles will tend to skid easier and will need a longer stopping distance.
formatted:
Gravel transition instructions:
(i) **slow down** and **look out for ditches or potholes** at the joint between gravel and tar, and
(ii) be aware that **steering will be lighter**, vehicles will **skid easier**, and **stopping distance will be longer**.

raw: Slow down and if it is not known how deep the water is, stop. If passable, drive through the water slowly.
formatted: **Slow down** and, if water depth is unknown, **stop**. If passable, **drive through the water slowly**.

raw: Consider both the alternative and the route indicated by this road traffic sign and decide in good time which to follow.
formatted: **Consider both the alternative and the toll route**, and **decide in good time** which to follow.

raw: Do not enter this area if you are driving motorcar.
formatted: **Do not enter this area** if you are driving a **midibus**.

raw: Make sure which exit you need to take and move in good time to the correct lane to leave the freeway.
formatted: **Make sure which exit you need** and **move in good time to the correct lane** to leave the freeway.

raw: Obey all other road traffic signs. Look out for vehicles, pedestrians and other hazards engaged in the experiment.
formatted: **Obey all other road traffic signs**. **Look out for vehicles, pedestrians and hazards** engaged in the experiment.

raw: Drive in such a way that you do not stop, park or drive over the island, unless on the orders of a traffic or police officer, to avoid a collision or in an emergency.
formatted: Drive in such a way that you **do not stop, park or drive over the island**, unless on **officer orders**, to **avoid a collision**, or in an **emergency**.

raw: The driver must be guided by the arrows and never, unless otherwise requested by a traffic officer, drive in the direction opposite to what the arrows show.
formatted: The driver **must be guided by the arrows** and **never drive in the opposite direction**, unless requested by a traffic officer.

raw: Do not drive or stop on the shoulder. If this is unavoidable, for example to avoid a collision, slow down as much as possible because the vehicle will pull in the direction of the shoulder when you move off the road.
formatted: **Do not drive or stop on the shoulder**. If unavoidable, **slow down as much as possible** because the vehicle will pull toward the shoulder.

raw: Stop if the STOP sign is displayed and move off or proceed with caution if safe when the GO sign is displayed.
formatted:
Stop-Go instructions:
(i) **stop if the STOP sign is displayed**, and
(ii) **move off or proceed with caution** if safe when the **GO sign is displayed**.

raw: Slow down immediately and be ready to stop if the light changes from green to amber. Make sure there are no pedestrians or cross-traffic who might not obey the signals.
formatted:
Traffic light warning action:
(i) **slow down immediately** and be **ready to stop** if the light changes from green to amber, and
(ii) **make sure there are no pedestrians** or cross-traffic who might not obey signals.

raw: Bring your vehicle to a standstill behind the stop line. If there is no stop line, the front of your vehicle must be brought to a stop in line with the stop sign. Proceed only when it is safe. If more than one vehicle stops at such an intersection, the vehicle, which stopped first, should move off first.
formatted:
4-Way Stop action:
(i) **bring your vehicle to a standstill** behind the stop line (or in line with the sign if no line exists),
(ii) **proceed only when it is safe**, and
(iii) if multiple vehicles stop, the **vehicle which stopped first** should **move off first**.

raw: Avoid driving to the left of the left-edge line. You may, however drive here only; whilst being overtaken by another vehicle, if you can so without endangering yourself, other traffic, pedestrians or property, during daytime and if persons and vehicles on the road are clearly discernible at a distance of at least 150 metres. It is not compulsory to drive to the left of the line when you are being overtaken, keep in mind that you have very little space when doing so. If your vehicle breaks down, stop as far left from the line as possible and switch on your emergency lights. The right-edge line is usually found on one-way roads such as dual carriageways or freeways and may not be crossed.
formatted:
Road edge line rules:
(i) **avoid driving to the left** of the left-edge line (permitted daytime only while being overtaken if clear visibility >150m),
(ii) if your vehicle breaks down, **stop as far left as possible** and **switch on emergency lights**, and
(iii) the **right-edge line** on dual carriageways or freeways **may not be crossed**.

raw: Look out for pedestrians crossing the road or near the road and be ready to stop.
formatted: **Look out for pedestrians** crossing or near the road and **be ready to stop**.

raw: Look out for other vehicles and yield to vehicles already in the circle or that will cross the yield line at their entrance to the circle before you will cross yours. Stop if necessary. The driver who reaches his/her yield line first may proceed first. At a mini circle you must, as at a normal intersection, signal in time in which direction you want to turn.
formatted:
Traffic circle action:
(i) **yield to vehicles already in the circle** or crossing the yield line first, and **stop if necessary**,
(ii) at mini-circles, the **driver reaching the line first** may proceed first, and
(iii) **signal in time** in which direction you want to turn.

raw: Slow down and, particularly in mountainous areas with sharp curves, be able to stop within the distance you can see. Remember to allow for a longer stopping distance on a descent especially when your vehicle is heavily laden.
formatted: **Slow down** and be able to **stop within sight distance**. Allow for a **longer stopping distance on a descent**, especially when heavily laden.

raw: If you intend to carry straight on, bring your vehicle to a standstill behind the stop line. When turning left, yield to all traffic, which is close enough to pose a hazard. Proceed only when it is safe.
formatted:
Yield-left turn action:
(i) if carrying straight on, **bring your vehicle to a standstill** behind the stop line, and
(ii) when turning left, **yield to all traffic close enough to pose a hazard**, proceeding only when safe.

raw: Look out for agricultural vehicles and slow down of they want to cross the road or are crossing it.
formatted: **Look out for agricultural vehicles** and **slow down** if they want to cross or are crossing.

raw: Look out for Fog or smoke and slow down. Be on the look out for other slow moving vehicles.
formatted: **Look out for fog or smoke**, **slow down**, and **be alert for slow moving vehicles**.

raw: Do not continue of your vehicle is wider than indicated on the sign.
formatted: **Do not continue** if your vehicle is **wider than indicated** on the sign.

raw: You need to know before hand in which direction you want to travel, e.g. North(N) or South(S).
formatted: **You need to know beforehand** in which direction you want to travel (e.g. North or South).

raw: Decide in advance whether you want to take the toll or alternative route. If you want to take the alternative route, slow down for the intersection. Remember that the alternative route is usually not of the same high standard as the toll route.
formatted:
Toll alternative rules:
(i) **decide in advance** whether to take the toll or alternative route,
(ii) **slow down for the intersection** if taking the alternative route, and
(iii) remember that alternative routes are **usually not of the same high standard** as toll routes.

raw: Do not use this route and look out for cyclists that could suddenly change direction to follow the cycle route.
formatted: **Do not use this route** and **look out for cyclists** who could suddenly change direction to follow the cycle route.

raw: Slow down and be ready to stop, turn left or right, depending on road traffic signs and signals and your destination.
formatted: **Slow down** and **be ready to stop or turn**, depending on traffic signs, signals, and your destination.

raw: Slow down and make sure you take the correct route. Also look out for other traffic at the intersection that might not yield.
formatted: **Slow down** to ensure you **take the correct route**, and **look out for non-yielding traffic** at the intersection.

raw: Note the destination and in particular note the distance to the destination so that you can plan your trip to fill up with petrol or rest.
formatted: **Note the destination and distance** in kilometres so you can **plan your trip for fuel or rest**.

raw: Do not pass to the right of W401 or TW401 and to the left of W402 or TW402
formatted: **Do not pass to the right** of W401/TW401 and **to the left** of W402/TW402.

raw: Slow down to take the curve at a safe speed or to be able to stop within the distance you can see.
formatted: **Slow down** to take the curve at a safe speed or to **be able to stop within sight distance**.

raw: Whenever a lane ends, converges, merges or is added, make sure in time that there is a big enough gap in the traffic to merge with the traffic. Also yield to other traffic, which might merge.
formatted: Whenever a lane ends, converges, merges or is added, **ensure a sufficient traffic gap to merge** in time, and **yield to other merging traffic**.

raw: Slow down and be aware that your vehicle may tend to the left or right if you straddle the step between the higher and lower level. Because of the ridge vehicles may also be slow to return to the higher level and could react suddenly if the wheel mounts the ridge. Do not make any sudden jerking steering motions, because it could cause you to lose control completely.
formatted:
Step level driving instructions:
(i) **slow down** and be aware your vehicle may pull left or right if straddling the step,
(ii) expect **sluggish or sudden wheel response** when mounting the ridge, and
(iii) **do not make sudden jerking steering motions** as it could cause loss of control.

raw: Decide on the direction and route you want to follow and position your vehicle to join the on-ramp at the freeway or proceed straight ahead.
formatted: **Decide on your direction and route**, and **position your vehicle** to join the on-ramp or proceed straight.

raw: Signal in time and make sure you are in the right-hand lane if you want to turn right to join the freeway.
formatted: **Signal in time** and **ensure you are in the right-hand lane** if turning right to join the freeway.

raw: Slow down and look out for other road traffic signs that indicate a specific hazard.
formatted: **Slow down** and **look out for other traffic signs** indicating a specific hazard.

raw: Slow down enough to be able to round the curves safely or stop within the sight distance you can see.
formatted: **Slow down enough** to **round the curves safely** or **stop within your sight distance**.

raw: If you are driving a heavy motor vehicle, engage a lower gear so that the vehicle will move down the descent more slowly. If the lower gear does not have the desired effect, engage an even lower gear to keep the speed constant and protect the brakes against overheating.
formatted:
Steep descent action:
(i) if driving a heavy motor vehicle, **engage a lower gear** to move down more slowly, and
(ii) if ineffective, **engage an even lower gear** to maintain constant speed and **protect brakes from overheating**.

raw: Whenever a lane ends, converges, merges or is added, make sure in time that there is a big enough gap in the traffic to merge with the traffic. Also yield to other traffic, which might merge.
formatted: Whenever a lane ends, converges, merges or is added, **ensure a sufficient traffic gap to merge** in time, and **yield to other merging traffic**.

raw: Whenever a lane ends, converges, merges or is added, make sure in time that there is a big enough gap in the traffic to merge with the traffic. Also yield to other traffic, which might merge.
formatted: Whenever a lane ends, converges, merges or is added, **ensure a sufficient traffic gap to merge** in time, and **yield to other merging traffic**.

raw: Change lanes in time if the lane you are travelling in ends. Check both the blind spots where two lanes end from both sides to make sure there is no other vehicle that is also changing lanes.
formatted:
Lane reduction action:
(i) **change lanes in time** if your lane ends, and
(ii) **check both blind spots** when two lanes end from both sides to avoid other changing vehicles.

raw: If possible maintain the recommended speed. However, make sure that it is safe to enter every intersection and look out for drivers that do not yield. The speed indicated is a recommendation and not a speed limit.
formatted:
Coordinated signals action:
(i) if possible, **maintain recommended speed** (which is a recommendation, not a speed limit), and
(ii) **ensure it is safe to enter** every intersection, looking out for drivers who do not yield.

raw: Do not move off when approaching traffic moves off. Wait until the signal is green. The sequence of the traffic signals at this intersection can be different during normal and during peak times.
formatted: **Do not move off** when approaching traffic moves off. **Wait until the signal is green**.

raw: Make sure that it is safe to slow down and stop to drop someone off or pick someone up. Also look out for pedestrians who may cross the road.
formatted: **Make sure it is safe to slow down and stop** to drop off or pick up passengers, and **look out for crossing pedestrians**.

raw: Do not cross the line, except to gain direct access to an entrance on the other side of the line, to gain direct access from such an entrance to the road or to pass a stationary obstruction. In all these cases you must ensure that it is safe to do so.
formatted: **Do not cross the line**, except to **gain access to an entrance** or **pass a stationary obstruction** when safe to do so.

raw: You may under no circumstances drive on the right hand side or cross these lines with any part of your vehicle, except to drive around a stationary vehicle or stationary obstruction in the road.
formatted: Under no circumstances **drive on the right side or cross these lines**, except to **drive around a stationary vehicle or obstruction**.

raw: Stop with the front of your vehicle behind the stop sign. If there is no stop sign, the stop line will have the same meaning as a stop sign.
formatted: **Stop with the front of your vehicle** behind the stop sign (or line if no sign exists).

raw: You may only drive a motorcar on this road or this part of the road. Where this sign is displayed, you must use that part of the road indicated by this sign. When driving one of the following vehicles, you may use such a road only when the sign depicting your type of vehicle is displayed.
formatted:
Motorcar lane rules:
(i) you **may only drive a motorcar** on this road or designated part, and
(ii) other vehicle types **may use the road only** when the sign depicting their specific vehicle type is displayed.

raw: Do no drive in the demarcated area.
formatted: **Do not drive** in the demarcated area.

raw: Give way to any one who crosses your path of travel or who wants to cross your path. Even if there is no yield sign, you still have to give way.
formatted: **Give way to anyone** who crosses your path of travel or wants to cross, even if **no yield sign is present**.

raw: Determine if a wind is blowing and from which direction. Any shielding of the wind by a truck, bridge or excavation will affect your vehicle and you should adjust the steering in time.
formatted: **Determine wind speed and direction**. Any shielding by trucks, bridges, or excavations will affect handling, so **adjust steering in time**.

raw: If the GVM or GCM of your vehicle exceeds the mass indicated in tons, use another road or part of the road, which is not indicated by this sign. If your vehicle's GVM or GCM is less than the indicated mass in tons, you may use this road.
formatted:
Heavy vehicle mass limit rules:
(i) if GVM or GCM **exceeds the indicated mass in tons**, use another road or unindicated part, and
(ii) if GVM or GCM is **less than the indicated mass**, you may use this road.

raw: If the noise level of your vehicle is high, you may not proceed past the sign, and for 100 metres after passing the sign, the vehicle's hooter may not be used.
formatted: If the noise level of your vehicle is high, **you may not proceed past the sign**, and for 100m after, the **hooter may not be used**.

raw: Where a left-turn prohibition is displayed, you may proceed straight or turn right. Where a right-turn prohibition is displayed, you may proceed straight or turn left.
formatted:
Turn prohibition rules:
(i) where a **left-turn prohibition is displayed**, you may proceed straight or turn right, and
(ii) where a **right-turn prohibition is displayed**, you may proceed straight or turn left.

raw: Slow down, yield to other traffic and be ready to stop if traffic intensity and volume require it. Look out for a traffic officer or stop sign that might be controlling the traffic.
formatted: **Slow down, yield to traffic**, and **be ready to stop**. Look out for a **traffic officer or stop sign** controlling traffic.

raw: Motorcyclists may not enter this part of the carriageway, or if this sign is displayed on a freeway, motorcyclists must leave at the first exit.
formatted: Motorcyclists **may not enter this part** of the carriageway, or if displayed on a freeway, motorcyclists **must leave at the first exit**.

raw: Do not stop to take up or drop passengers off if you are not driving a mini-bus of the organisation indicated on the sign. You may only wait with or park your mini-bus here if the road traffic sign indicates that the stop is a terminus.
formatted:
Minibus stop rules:
(i) **do not stop to pick up or drop off passengers** unless driving a minibus of the organization indicated, and
(ii) **you may only wait or park** here if the sign indicates that the stop is a **terminus**.

raw: Ensure that you drive at such a speed that you can take the curve safely or stop within the distance that you can see.
formatted: Ensure that you drive at such a speed that you can **take the curve safely** or **stop within sight distance**.

raw: Slow down immediately and look out for children who could be crossing the road unexpectedly or even be playing the road.
formatted: **Slow down immediately** and **look out for children** who could cross unexpectedly or be playing in the road.
